alcohol.answer: El Al's dangerous goods document lists whiskey and vodka as allowed in carry-on and checked baggage: more than 24% and up to 70% alcohol is limited to 5 litres total net per person, and drinks under 24% such as wine and beer have no restriction.

sections.h: 🍷 What El Al says about alcohol
sections.p: From the El Al document "Allowable Dangerous Goods carried by passengers" (English, revision 2 dated October 2022), read on 22 November 2026. It is an older document, so confirm it with El Al.

head: Question
El Al rule

5 litres total net quantity per person

list: Not on the page: the document does not explain duty-free bottles or the 100 ml cabin liquid limit for alcohol.

faq: How much alcohol can I take on El Al?
For drinks above 24% and up to 70% alcohol the limit is 5 litres total net per person; wine and beer under 24% have no restriction.
Can I carry spirits in hand baggage on El Al?
The El Al dangerous goods table marks alcoholic beverages as allowed in both carry-on and checked baggage, within the 5 litre limit.
